intro v
obtain ⟨I, hI⟩ := v
have hI1 : I ≠ 0 := by contradiction hI
have hI2 : Ideal.is_principal I := by contradiction hI
have hI3 : Ideal.absNorm I = Ideal.absNorm (Ideal.span {1}) := by rw [hI2]
have hI4 : Ideal.absNorm (Ideal.span {1}) = 1 := by rw [Ideal.absNorm_principal]
rw [hI3, hI4] at hI1
exact absurd hI1 rfl
